source: official impeccable npm installer (npx impeccable@latest install -y --providers=codex --scope=project --no-hooks)
binaryPolicy: Explicit IMPECCABLE_BIN and sibling binaries are trusted local development overrides; downloaded and version-pinned cached engines are checked against the manifest on every cache load.

localPatches.description: Shell and Windows launchers no longer trust verification stamps; manifest comments identify upstream-only release tools. Pinned engine digests and SKILL.md are unchanged.
